name: To be your Best Friend
source:
Kristel Adora Mendoza doesn't have many friends.

Except for one.

Kristel Mendoza and Chasity Cher have been childhood friends for life, but not by choice.

What does it truely mean to be Best Friends?

[From [url=https://compulsivecomputer.itch.io/to-be-your-best-friend]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
克里斯特尔·阿多拉·门多萨朋友寥寥。

唯独一人例外。

克里斯特尔·门多萨与查茜蒂·谢尔是一辈子的青梅竹马——但这并非出于两人的自愿选择。

究竟什么才叫真正的“挚友”？
